privileged_info_for_vlm: The PDB ID is 1TSR. The six hotspot residues are R175, G245, R248, R249, R273, and R282. R248 and R273 are DNA-contact residues (R248 binds the minor groove, R273 binds the phosphate backbone). R175, R249, and R282 are structural residues. G245 is often classified as DNA-contact/structural hybrid but primarily DNA-contact in this context. The image must be saved to /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/images/p53_dna_hotspots.png and the report to /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/p53_hotspot_report.txt.
